newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dec JGBs end Tokyo up but well off all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Dec JGBs end Tokyo up but well off all-time high.

text.p: The key December Japanese government bond ended Tokyo higher on Wednesday, but well off its all-time high of 124.36 touched in the morning session.

Just after the morning close, Jiji news agency quoted Chief Cabinet Secretary Seiroku Kajiyama as saying the government should look into what size of a stimulative package should be necessary as early as possible.

"The market was ready to test new highs in the afternoon, however, Kajiyama's remark, along with selling by overseas' speculators, knocked the December down below the chart support of 124.00," said a European brokerage trader.
